cl.x: Provide SikaRoof® VersiCell® Flex AU where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (September 2026, Version 01.01).

SikaRoof® VersiCell® Flex is a lightweight, high strength drainage module manufactured from re cycled polypropylene (PP) with cells 30 mm high, providing large internal void volumes for increased drainage discharge capacity. The module is flexible to accommodate curvatures of structural designs. SikaRoof® VersiCell® Flex forms a hollow space between the structural element and the planting media, providing excellent drainage to prevent flooding of the landscape features.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
cl.x: Drainage layer for intensive green roofs, podium landscapes and planter boxes in combination with a suitable geotextile as a filtration layer to prevent planting media from clogging the drainage layer
Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.2.
